players.name: Ariel Hukporti
players.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Adem Bona
players.detail: Bona (back) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.

players.name: Mark Williams
players.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jordan Goodwin
players.detail: Goodwin (calf) is questionable for Monday's game against the Spurs.

players.name: Ja Morant
players.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

players.name: Shaedon Sharpe
players.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Robert Williams III
players.detail: Williams (rest) won't play in Saturday's game against the Spurs.

players.name: Vit Krejci
players.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Maxime Raynaud
players.detail: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

players.name: Domantas Sabonis
players.detail: Sabonis (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Heat.

players.name: Ben Simmons
players.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

players.name: Keyonte George
players.detail: George will not return to Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right ankle injury.

players.name: Lauri Markkanen
players.detail: Markkanen (wrist) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.

players.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
players.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Jusuf Nurkic
players.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
